whatItIs: Qlab is an open-source project in the pulse and control category. It is maintained by BBN-Q and primarily looks like a MATLAB codebase. Measurement and control software for superconducting qubits.

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches pulse and control workflows in practice. readmeExcerpt: To get started, simply download and unzip the latest release.
